rule: Locked character sheets (face / hair / costume / never). Every named face on a plate needs stills/_locks/<id>.jpg; later episodes copy the first episode's lock byte-for-byte. Respectful, devotional, child-appropriate: no blood, no gore, no severed heads, no skulls.

markandeya.name: Markandeya (Mārkaṇḍeya)
markandeya.role: Narrator-sage of the Purana; frames every arc
markandeya.face: Ageless radiant sage who looks about forty (blessed to stay young), warm brown skin, calm large dark eyes, short neat dark-brown beard, three horizontal white ash lines (tripundra) with a small red dot on the forehead
markandeya.hair: Long dark-brown matted hair (jata) coiled in a high topknot bound with one rudraksha string; no crown
markandeya.costume: Bare chest with a long rudraksha mala, ochre-saffron dhoti and ochre shawl over the left shoulder, holds an open palm-leaf manuscript; barefoot
markandeya.never: white beard or white hair (that is Medhas), crown, jewels, weapons, elderly frail body, extra arms

medhas.name: Medhas (Medhā), the sage
medhas.role: Forest sage who tells the Devi Mahatmyam to Suratha and Samadhi
medhas.face: Elderly kind sage about seventy, fair-wheatish skin, gentle smiling eyes with laugh lines, long snow-white beard to the chest, vertical white-and-red sandal-paste tilak
medhas.hair: Long flowing snow-white hair to the shoulders with a small white topknot; no crown
medhas.costume: Bare chest with a tulsi-bead mala, plain cream-white cotton dhoti and cream shawl, sits on a spotted deerskin; brass kamandalu (water pot) and a wooden staff nearby; barefoot
medhas.never: dark hair, ochre-saffron robes (that is Markandeya), crown, jewels, weapons, stern or angry face, extra arms

suratha.name: King Suratha (Suratha)
suratha.role: Good king of the Chaitra line who loses his kingdom; later the Manu Savarni
suratha.face: Dignified king in his late thirties, wheat-brown skin, strong jaw, thick black upturned mustache, clean-shaven chin (no beard), honest worried dark eyes
suratha.hair: Shoulder-length wavy black hair under a tall gold crown (mukuta) set with one red ruby
suratha.costume: Royal indigo-blue angavastram (upper cloth) over a bare chest with a pearl necklace, gold earrings and armlets, cream silk dhoti with a gold border, gold-hilted sword sheathed at the waist; rides a white horse with a red-and-gold harness
suratha.never: beard, missing crown, armor helmet, drawn sword, saffron sage robes, extra arms

samadhi.name: Samadhi (Samādhi), the merchant
samadhi.role: Kind merchant cast out by his greedy wife and sons
samadhi.face: Gentle round-faced man about fifty, light brown skin, sad kind eyes, thin grey-streaked mustache, clean-shaven chin
samadhi.hair: Short grey-black hair under a simple white wrapped turban
samadhi.costume: Mustard-yellow shawl (uttariya) wrapped over the chest and shoulders, plain white dhoti, small gold ear-studs, one gold ring, slightly plump build, travel-worn but tidy, carries a small cloth bundle
samadhi.never: crown, sword, royal jewelry, indigo cloth (that is Suratha), sage robes, extra arms

devi.name: The Devi — Durga / Ambika / Chandika, as Mahishasuramardini
devi.role: The Great Goddess; heroine of all three charitras
devi.face: Radiant serene young goddess with a golden-fair glowing complexion, large compassionate lotus-shaped eyes, a gentle confident half-smile even in battle, small vertical third eye on the brow, red bindi
devi.hair: Long thick black hair flowing behind her, tall jeweled gold crown (karanda-mukuta) with a halo of light
devi.costume: Rich red silk sari with a broad gold border, gold necklaces, armlets and anklets; exactly TEN arms (five on each side, symmetric) holding the gods' gifts: trident (Shiva), discus (Vishnu), conch (Varuna), bow and arrows (Vayu), thunderbolt (Indra), sword and shield (Kala), mace, noose, and a lotus; rides a golden-maned lion (gift of Himavan), seated sideways or standing on it
devi.never: blood, wounds, severed heads, angry snarl or bared teeth, revealing or sexualized clothing, missing or extra arms, black skin (that is Kali), photoreal

lion.name: The Devi's lion (vahana)
lion.face: Majestic lion with a kind brave face, amber eyes
lion.costume: Tawny-gold coat, small gold ornaments on the brow; roars but never bites

mahishasura.name: Mahishasura (buffalo and human forms)
mahishasura.role: Buffalo-demon king who drives the gods from heaven (arc 2)
mahishasura.face: BUFFALO FORM: huge dark slate-grey water buffalo with sweeping curved horns, glowing amber eyes, flared nostrils, proud stance. HUMAN FORM: tall muscular asura king, dark grey-blue skin, proud scowl, thick black mustache, bushy eyebrows — fierce but not monstrous
mahishasura.hair: HUMAN FORM: wild black hair under a dark bronze helmet-crown with two curved buffalo horns
mahishasura.costume: HUMAN FORM: dark bronze breastplate and armlets, maroon dhoti, sword and round shield; in the final moment shown half-emerging from the buffalo, subdued under the Devi's trident with no wound shown
mahishasura.never: blood, gore, cut neck, severed head, visible wounds, horror-movie demon

vishnu_yoganidra.name: Vishnu in yoga-nidra (Anantashayana)
vishnu_yoganidra.role: Sleeps on Shesha at the cosmic dissolution (Ep02)
vishnu_yoganidra.face: Serene deep cloud-blue skin, eyes gently closed in yogic sleep, peaceful smile, white U-shaped namam tilak
vishnu_yoganidra.hair: Black curls under a tall gold kirita crown
vishnu_yoganidra.costume: Four arms (conch, discus, mace, lotus), yellow pitambar silk, kaustubha gem, vanamala flower garland; reclines on the coils of the many-hooded serpent Shesha on a calm milky cosmic ocean; Lakshmi optional at his feet
vishnu_yoganidra.never: Krishna's peacock feather or flute, two arms, open eyes before the Devi leaves him

brahma.name: Brahma
brahma.role: Creator; sings the hymn that wakes the Devi (Ep02)
brahma.face: Four bearded faces (three visible), ruddy-golden skin, kind wise eyes, long white beards
brahma.costume: Four arms holding palm-leaf Vedas, kamandalu, rosary and a lotus; white and red silks; seated on a pink lotus rising from Vishnu's navel
brahma.never: weapons, fear-distorted faces, extra heads beyond four

madhu_kaitabha.name: Madhu and Kaitabha (pair lock)
madhu_kaitabha.role: Two giant asura brothers born from Vishnu's ear-wax at the dissolution (Ep02)
madhu_kaitabha.face: MADHU: taller, dark green-grey skin, broad grin, big round eyes. KAITABHA: bronze-brown skin, pointed beard, sly smile. Both boastful and a little comic, not scary
madhu_kaitabha.hair: MADHU: bald with a gold helmet with two small horns. KAITABHA: wild red-black hair in a tall knot
madhu_kaitabha.costume: Gold-and-black armor, heavy maces, giant size wading in the cosmic ocean
madhu_kaitabha.never: blood, gore, severed heads, horror faces

kali.name: Kali / Chamunda
kali.role: Fierce protector who springs from the Devi's brow (Ep09–10)
kali.face: Fierce but protective face, deep blue-black skin, three wide bright eyes, tiny tip of red tongue, no fangs dripping
kali.hair: Wild flowing black hair like a storm cloud
kali.costume: Four arms with sword, noose, khatvanga staff and a gesture of protection (abhaya); tiger-skin wrap, garland of RED HIBISCUS FLOWERS (never skulls or heads), gold ornaments
kali.never: skulls, severed heads, blood, gore, corpses, nudity, horror styling

shumbha.name: Shumbha
shumbha.role: Asura emperor who conquers the three worlds (arc 3)
shumbha.face: Tall regal asura emperor, dark indigo skin, full black beard, proud piercing eyes
shumbha.hair: Long black hair under a tall spiked gold crown
shumbha.costume: Crimson-and-gold armor, royal purple cloak, gold-hilted sword; sits on a high gold throne

nishumbha.name: Nishumbha
nishumbha.face: Younger burly asura, slate-grey skin, thick black mustache only (no beard), hot-tempered eyes
nishumbha.hair: Black hair in a topknot under a bronze helmet-crown
nishumbha.costume: Green-bronze armor, heavy mace and bow, rides a chariot
nishumbha.never: full beard (that is Shumbha), blood, gore

raktabija.name: Raktabija
raktabija.role: Asura whose every falling drop becomes a copy of himself (Ep10)
raktabija.face: Hulking asura, deep maroon-red skin, glowing ember eyes, bald head with a black topknot
raktabija.hair: Bald with a single black topknot
raktabija.costume: Black iron armor, mace; his copies are shown as glowing RED SPARKS that sprout smaller look-alike figures — never blood
raktabija.never: blood, bleeding wounds, gore, puddles of blood
